notes: Authoritative record spec for the Breton tradition pilot. BUDGET VERDICT = Overstack Risk; discipline is the point. GATE TYPE = STATE-enum-gated (R7): rewards gate on PDV_State_BretonTradition (KnightsRoad=0 | HiddenArt=1 | GreenWay=2) plus the active tradition's focused patron tier within that state. ONLY the active tradition's focused reward family pays at a time (the other two are suppressed) -- this is the Overstack Risk control. BROAD LANE = the Tradition STATE, not a deity (R1): broad T1 fills the FIXED manager property PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T1 (R2) granted via PATRON_STATE_BROAD; broad T2 is PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T2 (new). NO flat Breton pantheon or generic broad-worship deity. Breton OWNS NO Aedric deities (R5): Knight's Road focuses REUSE Imperial-owned Divines (Akatosh/Stendarr/Arkay/Mara) create:false + Stance_Breton NATIVE; Hidden Art lawful-occult may reuse Julianos; Green Way nature may reuse Kynareth. Hidden Art Daedric forks and Green Way werewolf/Daedric forks route through the existing Phase 20C Daedric system (R6) -- NO new records here. THREE STANDING TRACKS (KnightlyVowIntegrity, WitchcraftExposure, DruidicStanding) are PRESSURE ONLY: they modify access/penalty/rupture and NEVER pay a second or third always-on boon family; they must not all pay positive rewards at once. Hidden Art focused rewards are stronger ONLY because WitchcraftExposure/rupture/Vigilant pressure is the price (magnitude conditioned on visible exposure cost). T3 NPC recognition is V1-deferred (PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md); V1 T3 ships stat/signature effects with Champion Survey text as the recognition surface. Player-facing text is ASCII-only and uses Skyrim ActorValue names. No magnitude exceeds ~12%. Broad stays softer than focused.

v1RecognitionSurface: Champion Survey/status text only (non-voiced). The tradition Survey reports the active PDV_State_BretonTradition spine, KnightlyVowIntegrity/WitchcraftExposure/DruidicStanding bands, PDV_State_BretonDruidicFork, curse posture, and WHY parallel tradition rewards are not all active. Voiced NPC recognition lines are V2 per PDV_RecognitionDialogueScalePacket.md.
budget: Two always-on families only: broad Tradition lane (Layer 1, capped at T2/Faithful) + the ONE active tradition's focused family (Layer 2, T1/T2/T3, selected by PDV_State_BretonTradition). The other two focused families are suppressed. The three standing tracks (KnightlyVowIntegrity/WitchcraftExposure/DruidicStanding) MODIFY access/penalty/rupture and are NOT a third buff track; they must not all pay positive rewards at once. Hidden Art is the strongest focused family ONLY because WitchcraftExposure/rupture/Vigilant pressure is its price. At the PDV_RaceRewardBudgetLedger Breton ceiling: 'One tradition spine plus one focused patron within it; cross-track pressure modifies or penalizes but adds no extra always-on boon family.' No magnitude exceeds ~12%. Broad stays softer than every focused family.

authoringPlan.vehicle: Author with a Phase 20 Breton Mutagen helper (mirror tools/pdv-phase20-khajiit-author with an --author-rewards mode reading this spec); one backed-up framework-ESP write. Reuse reward-author patterns (EnsureMagicEffect/ConfigureMagicEffect/EnsureSpell/ConfigureSpell/ParseActorValue). NO night-condition wiring (Breton has no lunar/substrate layer). NO new deity QUSTs.
authoringPlan.recordCreation: Create 16 net-new SPEL with their MGEFs: broad Tradition T1/T2 (2; T1 record fills the EXISTING manager property PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T1, T2 is new) + 3 tradition focused families x T1/T2/T3 (9: KnightsRoad/HiddenArt/GreenWay) + 4 creed-loss SPEL (vow-integrity/exposure-rupture/excommunication/druidic-fork-betrayal) + PDV_SPEL_Neglect_Breton (1). Create ZERO deity QUSTs: Breton OWNS no Aedric deities (R5). REUSE Imperial-owned Akatosh/Stendarr/Arkay/Mara/Julianos and Kynareth (create:false) by adding Stance_Breton NATIVE; this is a reconcile-shared-deity stance add, not record creation. Daedric forks route through the existing Phase 20C system (R6); create no Daedric records.
authoringPlan.stanceReconcile: For each reused deity (Akatosh/Stendarr/Arkay/Mara/Julianos/Kynareth), run the author tool's --reconcile-shared-deity mode to add Stance_Breton=0 (NATIVE) without recreating the QUST. The Imperial owner spec must have authored these records first (authoring order: Imperial before Breton).
authoringPlan.noDeityQuestStructureNeeded: Because Breton creates no deity QUSTs, there is no new SGE+SEQ work here. (Reused deities already carry SGE+SEQ from their Imperial-owner authoring run; the BaanDar SGE-omission failure mode does not apply to a pure stance-reconcile.)

authoringPlan.wiring: Same run: add Stance_Breton NATIVE to the 6 reused deity QUSTs; do NOT add anything to FLST 017E47 (reused deities already present). The broad Tradition T1 fills the existing PDV_Bless_Breton_Tradition_T1 manager property and is granted via the broad-worship path (PATRON_STATE_BROAD); Tradition T2 is a new broad property. Wire the 9 focused tradition reward props (KnightsRoad/HiddenArt/GreenWay T1/T2/T3) gated on PDV_State_BretonTradition (one active tradition selects the eligible family; suppress the other two) + 4 creed-loss SPEL props + PDV_SPEL_Neglect_Breton. Hidden Art reward props additionally check WitchcraftExposure (magnitude conditioned on exposure cost; rupture revokes). The three standing tracks are wired as access/penalty/rupture modifiers only, never as boon grants.
